value.residual: The closed Rust validator requires immutable source resolution, evidence, integer confidence in 0..10000, non-empty reviewer identity, a shared UTC review timestamp subset, and at most one direct supersession edge to an active same-term/same-pinned-source mapping; adversarial tests cover missing/range/time/unresolved/self/cross-identity/chained cases and valid direct replacement. Quint checks the two-record direct-replacement protocol and Lean proves the compact closed predicate's confidence, review, identity-preservation, direct-terminal, and exactly-one-active consequences. Reviewer strings are not authenticated principals, confidence/evidence truth is not machine-established, timestamp parsing and arbitrary graphs are outside the formal abstractions, and no correspondence proof exists.
